author: /root/advance_integer_witnesses
claim: Simultaneous four-guard analytic avoidance, compact bounds before progressions, component-aware dense positive-tail selection, and exact actual-rational-guard consumer under explicit real-orbit inputs.

obligations.name: Analytic source theorem
obligations.required_input: A multivariable real analytic identity principle on a connected covering domain.
obligations.constructed_input: AnalyticOnNhd ℝ f univ on an arbitrary real normed vector space, with f0≠0.
obligations.justification: A nonempty open zero set would give neighborhood equality to zero, then equality on the preconnected whole space, contradicting f0≠0. No isolated-zero theorem in one variable is misapplied.

obligations.name: Covering and topology
obligations.required_input: Actual guard functions on the orbit component, with an independent topology.
obligations.constructed_input: An explicit continuous surjective π:V→G and continuous g_j, whose pullbacks are analytic.
obligations.justification: Every nonempty open set in G has nonempty open preimage. Density of nonzeros upstairs descends. No topology is transported and the actual elliptic cover remains a required construction.

obligations.name: Finite index coverage and simultaneous choice
obligations.required_input: All four rational trace guards must hold at the same point with scalar and pole conditions.
obligations.constructed_input: Exactly Fin4 is intersected with the supplied nonempty open Ω and open dense A.
obligations.justification: good_eq enumerates0,1,2,3. Finite intersections of open dense sets remain dense, giving one point satisfying every condition.

obligations.name: Compact bounds and choice order
obligations.required_input: Uniform guard inverse bounds must be fixed before contact primes and resulting progressions.
obligations.constructed_input: A PositiveCompacts K and four positive ε_j bounding |g_j| below on K are existentially chosen before universally quantified a,b and B.
obligations.justification: Local compactness gives K with nonempty interior inside the good region. Extreme-value bounds apply to continuous absolute values positive on K. CompactSpace supplies local compactness.

obligations.name: Positive progression tails
obligations.required_input: The chosen positive tail must meet the open good region arbitrarily late, not just contain arbitrarily large indices.
obligations.constructed_input: positive_tail derives ∃n>B with b+n•a∈U from dense integer cyclic orbit in a compact topological abelian group.
obligations.justification: The actual compact recurrence theorem supplies a cluster point at x−b of the positive orbit; its neighborhood characterization gives frequently-atTop hits.

obligations.name: Components and step maps
obligations.required_input: The original generator can lie outside G⁰; multiplication and component factors must be explicit.
obligations.constructed_input: component_step_mem derives kG⊆H from mG⊆H and m|k; dense_component_multiple uses actual continuous surjective x↦kx into H.
obligations.justification: No membership of P in H is assumed. Surjectivity on H is an explicit input, and is separately derived from a genuine surjective additive real cover for every k≠0.
obligations.source_references: component_step_mem; dense_component_multiple; real_cover_multiplication_surjective; source real-progression lemma

obligations.name: Actual rational guard identity
obligations.required_input: The selected analytic nonzeros must be the literal rational trace coefficients for actual H=[h]P.
obligations.constructed_input: cover_nonzero consumes RealGuardTrace318.guard_at_identity_positive; select_actual_guards requires the exact along-progression comparison with rational guardValue.
obligations.justification: Nonzero guard values for selected H are outputs. Exact ℚ→ℝ casting is reflected by injectivity. h>0 gives actual H≠0 using the original nontorsion theorem.

obligations.name: Congruences and remaining arithmetic
obligations.required_input: The selected h must retain permitted residue classes without claiming the prime-pattern inputs.
obligations.constructed_input: progression_modEq proves r+kt≡r mod d whenever d|k. The consumer explicitly uses h=r+kt with k>0.
obligations.justification: This combines with the existing CRT progression once supplied. It does not establish prime-pattern coprimalities, the quantitative scalar-region estimate, or coherent chart existence.

obligations.name: Verification and bounded scope
obligations.required_input: Exact final sources and all generated/private declarations must be checked without hiding missing actual structures.
obligations.constructed_input: Three strict-checked modules, private-inclusive recursive audit, explicit predecessor bindings and primary-source locators.
obligations.justification: This is an isolated conditional selection packet. The actual real torus/cover, scalar region, orbit comparison, chart preparation and remaining source equations are still open. Fresh non-author review is required.
